cases.name: a v5 session: connect, subscribe, publish fan-out at QoS 1, puback, ping, unsubscribe, disconnect
a v3 session: credentials, return codes for denied filters, QoS 0 delivery to itself
refused CONNECTs close the connection (v5 reason code, v3 return codes)
enhanced authentication: a challenge, then CONNACK from onAuthenticate (the connection is not marked active)
re-authentication: success, then a refusal with a DISCONNECT that closes
an empty AUTH body is a success; a v3 connection refused by AUTH gets a v3 DISCONNECT
errors: a handler exception and an undecodable packet go to the error callbacks with stage receive and close the connection
adapter failures: start, send and close errors
keep-alive: open schedules the CONNECT grace, packets re-arm the negotiated keep-alive, a tick closes the connection
DISCONNECT cleans up, closes, and re-arms the keep-alive of the closed connection
packets before CONNECT and unknown types; a packet from a connection never opened
the Session Present flag of an accepted CONNACK is not sent
subscriber QoS: a publish's QoS, the granted QoS and 1, whichever is lowest; QoS 2 publishes are not acknowledged
a server on a NoTimer adapter
a server-initiated unsubscribe stops delivery to that connection only; absent filters and connections are a no-op
